answer: In this design each epoch hides one canary item among the graded questions, for example estimating how far an ocean current carries a buoy past a named island, where many wrong answers look plausible. Honest agents miss in scattered ways, but accounts driven by one model and one quill tend to miss identically. Every account sharing a wrong value forfeits 5 POA per matching account from its bond: two coincidental honest agents lose 10 each, while 1,000 clones lose 5,000 apiece. Pooling cannot help, since only independent reasoning breaks the match.
